testDefinitions.notes: USP <191> Chemical Identification Tests, Zinc. Dissolve 0.1 g in 5 mL water; add 0.2 mL strong sodium hydroxide solution: a white precipitate is formed (source: Zinc Sulfate Monohydrate__Zinc Sulfate Monohydrate-SM-USP.txt:30).

USP <191> Chemical Identification Tests, Sulfate. With barium chloride TS, solutions of sulfates yield a white precipitate insoluble in hydrochloric acid and in nitric acid (source: Zinc Sulfate Monohydrate__Zinc Sulfate Monohydrate-SM-USP.txt:30).

USP <251> Procedure 1 (chemical method). Standard 0.50 mL lead standard solution (10 ppm) in comparison tube; test 0.25 g zinc sulfate in 5 mL water with 10 mL potassium cyanide solution (1 in 10); add 0.1 mL sodium sulfide TS, stand 5 min. Sample not darker than standard (NMT 20 ppm) (source: Zinc Sulfate Monohydrate__Zinc Sulfate Monohydrate-SM-USP.txt:31).

USP <211> Procedure 1 (colorimetry). Standard 3.0 mL standard arsenic solution; test equivalent to 215 mg zinc sulfate in 35 mL water with 20 mL 7 N sulfuric acid, 2 mL potassium iodide TS, 0.5 mL stronger acid stannous chloride TS, 1 mL isopropyl alcohol; generate hydrogen with 3.0 g granular zinc for 45 min into silver diethyldithiocarbamate TS. Any red colour does not exceed standard (NMT 14 ppm) (source: Zinc Sulfate Monohydrate__Zinc Sulfate Monohydrate-SM-USP.txt:32).

USP 2022 Monograph for Zinc Sulfate Monohydrate. Dissolve equivalent of 1.12 g zinc sulfate in 150 mL water in 200 mL volumetric flask, precipitate zinc with ammonium sulfide TS, dilute to volume, filter; to 100 mL filtrate add sulfuric acid, evaporate to dryness in tared dish, ignite. Residue NMT 5 mg (0.9%). Analyst enters the final values (dual residue weight mg and percentage % limits cannot be calculated by gravimetric workflow) (source: Zinc Sulfate Monohydrate__Zinc Sulfate Monohydrate-SM-USP.txt:33).

USP 2022 Monograph for Zinc Sulfate Monohydrate. Sample solution equivalent to 28 mg/mL zinc sulfate; the sample solution is not coloured pink by methyl orange TS (source: Zinc Sulfate Monohydrate__Zinc Sulfate Monohydrate-SM-USP.txt:34).

testDefinitions.displayName: Assay of zinc sulfate (USP, complexometric titration)
testDefinitions.titrationEquivalencyFactorDerivation: stated: 1 mL of 0.05 M edetate disodium = 8.072 mg ZnSO4; 8.072 / 0.05 = 161.44 mg/mmol
testDefinitions.notes: Sample equivalent to 170 mg ZnSO4 in 100 mL water, 5 mL ammonia-ammonium chloride buffer TS, 50 mg Eriochrome black TS, titrate with 0.05 M edetate disodium to deep blue endpoint. Factor 161.44 mg/mmol (8.072 / 0.05). Shared by ZnSO4 and ZnSO4.H2O rows (source: Zinc Sulfate Monohydrate__Zinc Sulfate Monohydrate-SM-USP.txt:35).

BP Appendix VI Qualitative Reactions and Tests, Sulfate. 5 mL of solution S + 1 mL dilute hydrochloric acid + 1 mL barium chloride solution R1: white precipitate is formed (source: Zinc Sulfate Monohydrate__Zinc Sulfate Monohydrate-SM.txt:30).

BP Appendix VI Qualitative Reactions and Tests, Zinc. 5 mL prescribed solution + 0.2 mL strong NaOH (white precipitate), + 2 mL strong NaOH (precipitate dissolves), + 10 mL ammonium chloride solution (clear), + 0.1 mL sodium sulfide solution: flocculent white precipitate (source: Zinc Sulfate Monohydrate__Zinc Sulfate Monohydrate-SM.txt:30).

testDefinitions.displayName: Assay of zinc sulfate monohydrate (BP, complexometric titration)
testDefinitions.titrationEquivalencyFactorDerivation: stated: 1 mL of 0.1 M sodium edetate = 17.95 mg ZnSO4,H2O; 17.95 / 0.1 = 179.5 mg/mmol
testDefinitions.notes: BP Appendix VIII D Complexometric Titrations. Dissolve 0.160 g in 5 mL dilute acetic acid, dilute to 200 mL with water, add ~50 mg xylenol orange triturate and hexamethylenetetramine until violet-pink, add 2 g hexamethylenetetramine in excess, titrate with 0.1 M sodium edetate to yellow. Factor 179.5 mg/mmol (17.95 / 0.1) (source: Zinc Sulfate Monohydrate__Zinc Sulfate Monohydrate-SM.txt:38).
